name: Journey Mode
author: Atos Vinicius
description: A story mode with a walkable 3D world: character creation, 30 people in 16 areas over eight chapters, the game's own text boxes and duels with a deck for each duelist, area music, a title menu of NEW GAME / CONTINUE / OPTIONS, a START menu, a save file and two endings. Characters: Quaternius (CC0); props: PSX Nature Free by heyheythere (CC BY 4.0).
